caption: ORACLE (privileged GT, scripted)
note: Scripted controller on simulator ground truth (privileged ball/bowl positions). Not a policy; never an upper bound for a learned result.
rolled_out_note: rolled_out is TrialTracker.rolled_out (real2sim.evaluation.metrics): an in_bowl True->False transition with the ball unheld on both ticks; a held ball lowered through the rim band never counts.
ik_rejections_note: ik_rejections count IK solves rejected during PRE_GRASP..RETREAT only; the DONE phase holds the current pose without solving IK.

start_region.provenance: DATA-DERIVED v4 (2026-10-13): ball centroid of the first frame of episodes 0-7 back-projected through the operator-measured camera onto the ball-centre plane, n=8, std 1.0/1.6 cm; operator reports ~15 in from the table edge
